issue.title: Zoom panel modal's LLMCallsVisibilityChanged handler never dispatches (same Textual handler-name bug fixed for AgentDetail)
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-12z.5.2 as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and independently verified still present on master 624a29ea7 by the sase-12z.5 land agent on 2026-09-20.

task_type_fields.impact:
The zoom modal never learns that the LLM Calls panel has content, so whatever state that
message drives (on the Agents detail it is which secondary layouts the view picker may
select) is permanently stuck at its initial value inside the zoom modal. Decide whether
the modal needs the same `@on(LLMCallsVisibilityChanged)` decorator or whether the handler
is genuinely dead and should be deleted; if it is wired up, refresh any zoom PNG goldens
it changes and add a dispatch regression test mirroring the AgentDetail one.
task_type_fields.repro:
`grep -n "on_llm_calls_visibility_changed" src/sase/ace/tui/modals/zoom_panel_modal.py`
shows the modal still defines a bare `on_llm_calls_visibility_changed` method (line 345)
that delegates to the shared `on_llm_calls_visibility_changed` helper. Textual derives a
message's handler name from its class name, and `LLMCallsVisibilityChanged` collapses to
`on_llmcalls_visibility_changed`, so the naming convention alone never dispatches this
message and the modal's handler is dead code.

Epic sase-12z.5 (phase sase-12z.5.2, commit 9a56fc129) fixed the identical latent bug on
`AgentDetailPanelMixin` in `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_agent_detail_panels.py` by adding
`@on(LLMCallsVisibilityChanged)` above the same-named method, and added a regression test
(`tests/ace/tui/test_agent_view_picker.py::test_agents_llm_calls_panel_message_enables_picker_layouts`).
The zoom modal was left untouched because fixing it changes zoom-panel rendering and needs
its own golden refresh.

payload.description: Epic sase-12z.5 (commit 9a56fc129) fixed the identical Textual handler-name bug on AgentDetailPanelMixin with @on(LLMCallsVisibilityChanged) and added a dispatch regression test; copy that fix and its test shape here.

payload.entry: Verified by the sase-14n land agent at master 87c604833. b3550b56e adds @on(LLMCallsVisibilityChanged) to the zoom modal (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/zoom_panel_modal.py). The regression test test_zoom_modal_llm_calls_visibility_message_dispatches posts the message through real dispatch, and tests/ace/tui/test_agents_zoom_panel_modal.py passes.
